verdict.rationale: Connect exposes many core workflows programmatically: API-based onboarding as an alternative to embedded or hosted UI (docs-5), connected-account balance retrieval via API calls (docs-18), payout management (docs-7), and webhooks (docs-15), with an official CLI and MCP server also documented (probe-4, probe-5). However, several capabilities are framed as Dashboard or no-code features with no stated API equivalent, including pricing tools (docs-8), account review and actions (docs-9), and dispute viewing (docs-17), and no OpenAPI spec was found at the probed docs paths (probe-3). Missing for 10: an explicit statement of API/UI parity, API equivalents for the Dashboard-only pricing tools and account-management actions, a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of full API coverage.
